public_rule: Do not publish model names. These profiles are internal production controls for consistent outfit imagery.

profiles.reader_projection: A polished Taiwan office worker who makes practical workwear feel elegant and reachable.
profiles.visual_profile: Taiwanese woman, late 20s to early 30s, soft oval face, shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural warm fair skin, calm expression, average-slim healthy proportions, 160-165cm visual height.
profiles.style_range: button shirts, knit tops, blazers, tailored trousers, midi skirts, loafers, low heels, structured bags, quiet neutral layers.
profiles.daily_scenes: MRT-adjacent walkway, office lobby, elevator hall, cafe before work, shaded city sidewalk.
profiles.avoid: supermodel proportions, luxury hotel background, runway pose, hard power-suit styling, visible logos, overly perfect beauty lighting

profiles.reader_projection: A weekend and date outfit reference with soft styling, approachable charm, and easy visual appeal.
profiles.visual_profile: Taiwanese woman, mid to late 20s, slightly round face, long dark brown hair with soft movement, natural makeup, relaxed posture, average height and healthy slim build.
profiles.style_range: dresses, skirts, light cardigans, sheer layers, ballet flats, Mary Janes, small shoulder bags, soft color palettes.
profiles.daily_scenes: cafe window, bookstore street, department store fitting area, quiet shopping street, afternoon city corner.
profiles.avoid: glamour model pose, bridal styling, luxury resort, excessive sweetness, plastic skin, heavy filters

profiles.reader_projection: A practical casual reference for small-budget daily outfits that still look clean and intentional.
profiles.visual_profile: Taiwanese woman, late 20s, gentle square-oval face, short-to-medium dark hair or low ponytail, natural skin texture, approachable expression, average petite-to-medium proportions.
profiles.style_range: T-shirts, denim, relaxed shirts, light outerwear, rain-friendly layers, sneakers, flat sandals, canvas or nylon bags.
profiles.daily_scenes: neighborhood street, convenience-store corner, covered sidewalk, casual cafe, rainy MRT exit.
profiles.avoid: athleisure brand-ad look, streetwear hype styling, luxury bag focus, exaggerated pose, childlike styling, obvious AI smoothness
